AstroMicroNet_and_Rombach: Identical to v7 reference results on the same networks.
parameter_selection: Exploratory search to reproduce cross-computer distribution; approved by author for this revision. Not selected as the best BE F1 and not independent confirmation.
statistics: Two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank, jointly BH across 12 comparisons; 99,999 within-network label permutations for overall Friedman test. P values do not account for parameter search.
